description: Browse Haven menus, compare locations, and plan a meal from saved prices.

novel_features.name: Location price comparison
novel_features.description: Compare the same named menu item across saved location menus.

novel_features.name: Base-price meal subtotal
novel_features.description: Estimate a meal base-price subtotal from explicit item IDs and quantities.

novel_features.name: Saved menu changes
novel_features.description: Show additions, removals, price and availability changes between two complete saved menus.

novel_features.name: Shared availability
novel_features.description: Find items marked available in every selected saved location menu.

novel_features.name: Nearby locations
novel_features.description: Rank saved shops by straight-line distance from supplied coordinates.
